text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD-ENG-EU triggered for service eu-inference-5xx. Condition: 60m 5xx rate > 5%. Incident: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/PD12345 :rotating_light:

pagerbot: Auto-assigning on-call. Notified rotation: eng-oncall-eu.

sophia: acked. I'm taking primary on this — joining a quick bridge. Creating adhoc bridge now.

raj: ack from me (APAC oncall). I can assist with logs + fallback routing if needed.

emily: CS FYI — we already have 2 customer reports in Zendesk referencing timeouts on generation. Marking as possible impact.

sophia: quick summary: spike of 502/5xx from inference-eu-02 pool starting 08:12 UTC. Error pattern looks like model server returning 502s after ~3s. Could be overloaded or a new quantization profile regressed.

sophia: running healthcheck on a few hosts:
```
# health check
curl -sS https://inference-eu-02.redwood.internal/health || echo "down"
# sample request to reproduce
curl -sS -X POST https://inference-eu-02.redwood.internal/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -w "%{http_code}\n"
```

raj: I pulled the recent deploys — we rolled quant-profile v3 to eu pool at 07:58 UTC. Canary looked okay but volume was low. Suggest trying quick rollback of quant-profile on one node to confirm.

sophia: agreed. Mitigation plan (temp):
1) disable quant-profile v3 on eu pool
2) scale eu pool +2 nodes autoscaler override
3) enable fallback routing to hosted-light model for customer requests during mitigation
4) gather logs + flamegraphs, revert permanently if confirmed

sophia: running rollback command (patching config for pool eu-inference-02):
```bash
kubectl -n inference patch configmap eu-quant-config -p '{"data":{"active_profile":"v2"}}'
```

pagerbot: Command triggered by sophia: patch configmap eu-quant-config. Noting audit. If no patch success in 2m, will escalate to eng-sre.

emily: CS update: Posting message to the 4 affected customers with initial note and that we're investigating. Will escalate if they ask for ETA.

raj: logs from model server around 08:14 UTC show repeated OOM-ish tracebacks and worker restarts. Snippet:
```
ERROR [worker-17] rk_model_server: AllocError: failed to allocate workspace 0x7fae...
2025-05-02T08:14:12Z WARN worker-17 restart (reason=OOM, pid=4321)
```

sophia: that matches hypothesized regression from quant-profile v3 (memory footprint higher). After patching config, I'm cycling one pod to v2 to validate.

sophia: cycling pod now: `kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment eu-model-deploy --field-selector=spec.template.metadata.annotations.rollback=true` (will monitor).

pagerbot: Deployment rollout restart requested by sophia. Watching rollout status.

raj: I've also prepped fallback route — adding weighted routing to hosted-light (10% initially) to reduce pressure while we confirm. Command: `routectl set-weight eu-inference /models/large 90 /models/hosted-light 10`

sophia: rollback on one pod completed. Healthcheck returns 200 and sample generation succeeded (response latency 320ms).

emily: CS: customers A and B confirmed partial recovery for requests that were failing earlier. They're seeing reduced 502s.

sophia: scaling override applied +2 nodes — cluster metrics show CPU and memory trending down on rolled-back pods.

pagerbot: Auto-escalation suppressed because owner assigned (sophia). If condition persists after 15m, will escalate to ENG-SRE lead.

raj: will keep running log collection and test a few heavy prompts across eu nodes. Also opening a follow-up task to validate quant-profile v3 memory assumptions in staging.

sophia: current status: INVESTIGATING -> partial mitigation applied (rollback, scale, routed fallback). ETA next update 15m.

emily: CS will send a follow-up to affected customers with "partial mitigation in place, investigating root cause, ETA ~15-30m".

sophia: noted. Recording runbook actions in incident PD. Adding links:
- runbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/ENG/Inference+5xx+runbook
- playbook snippet: https://gist.github.com/sophia/quant-rollback-playbook

raj: FYI leaving a short grep to capture reproducible traces:
```bash
kubectl -n inference logs eu-model-deploy-abc --since=30m | grep -E "OOM|AllocError|worker-restart"
```

sophia: marking this thread: owner=sophia, delegated=raj (support), bridging=true. Will post final status after we confirm stable 10m of healthy metrics. :white_check_mark:

emily: CS will keep customers updated. If anything changes, ping #customer-status.

sophia: last check (08:29 UTC): 5xx rate down from 6.2% -> 1.1% on eu-inference-02. Monitoring. If it holds we'll close PD and file a postmortem.

raj: copying log archive to /artifacts/incidents/PD12345/logs.tar.gz for postmortem.

sophia: will confirm closure in ~10m if metrics stable. Thanks all.
